result.summary: Corporate segment generates the most revenue at 210905.52.

findings.statement: The corporate customer segment generates the highest total revenue among all segments.
findings.evidence: corporate: 271 orders, 210905.52 total revenue; retail: 469 orders, 162517.99 total revenue; government: 60 orders, 20909.96 total revenue
findings.method: SQL aggregation with JOIN between orders and customers tables, grouped by segment and summed order_value
findings.code: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(o.order_value) as total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

data_quality_notes: orders table: 0 nulls in any column (0.0% for all columns)
customers table: 0 nulls in any column
assumptions: Revenue is calculated as sum of order_value from orders table
Customer segments are defined in customers.parquet segment column
limitations: All three segments have more than 30 rows (corporate: 271, retail: 469, government: 60), so no small sample concerns
